# Story Hour Academy

> Story Hour Academy is a free, self-paced reading curriculum that teaches phonics and beginning reading skills to children through 112 online lessons. Built on structured literacy principles and the Science of Reading, it includes video instruction, interactive exercises, decodable reading materials, classic literature selections, pretests, and mastery tests. Lesson content, images, and audio are dedicated to the public domain under Creative Commons Zero (CC0) 1.0 Universal. The source code is available under the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) No Attribution license. Third-party material such as YouTube videos remains under its original license.

## Sitemaps

- [XML Sitemap](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/sitemap.xml): Includes all crawlable and indexable pages.

- [Tests](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/tests): Diagnostic pretests and mastery tests for phonics and reading skills. Identify where students need help with consonants, vowels, phonograms, and syllable types.
- [Book List](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/book-list): Complete list of classic literature used in the Story Hour Academy reading curriculum, sortable by title, author, or publication date.

## Units

- [Unit 1: Single-Sound Consonants](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-1): Learn 16 single-sound consonant letters (b, d, f, h, j, k, l, m, n, p, qu, r, t, v, w, z) and their sounds in this free reading curriculum.
- [Unit 2: Consonant Digraphs](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-2): Learn six consonant digraphs (ck, ch, ng, sh, th, wh) that represent single sounds in this free reading curriculum.
- [Unit 3: Multi-Letter Vowel Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-3): Learn 19 multi-letter vowel phonograms and start blending sounds into words in this free reading curriculum.
- [Unit 4: Vowel Letters](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-4): Learn vowel letters a, e, i, o, u, y and the multiple sounds each can represent in this free reading curriculum.
- [Unit 5: Multi-Sound Consonant Letters](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-5): Learn multi-sound consonant letters c, g, s, x and the sounds they make in different contexts.
- [Unit 6: Syllable Types](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-6): Learn six syllable types: closed, open, consonant-le, r-controlled, vowel-consonant-e, and vowel team.
- [Unit 7: The Schwa Sound](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-7): Learn about the schwa sound, the most common vowel sound in English, and identify it in words.
- [Unit 8: More Single-Sound Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-8): Learn nine more single-sound phonograms (tch, ph, rh, gh, gn, kn, wr, dg, aigh) for advanced reading.
- [Unit 9: More Multi-Sound Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/unit-9): Learn 15 more multi-sound phonograms to complete the Story Hour Academy reading curriculum.

## Assessments

- [Pretest: Single-Sound Consonants (Lowercase)](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/pretest-1): Pretest 16 single-sound consonant letters in lowercase: b, d, f, h, j, k, l, m, n, p, qu, r, t, v, w, z.
- [Mastery Test: Single-Sound Consonants (Lowercase)](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/test-1): Mastery test for 16 single-sound consonant letters in lowercase.
- [Pretest: Single-Sound Consonants (Uppercase)](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/pretest-2): Pretest 16 single-sound consonant letters in uppercase: B, D, F, H, J, K, L, M, N, P, Qu, R, T, V, W, Z.
- [Mastery Test: Single-Sound Consonants (Uppercase)](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/test-2): Mastery test for 16 single-sound consonant letters in uppercase.
- [Pretest: Consonants and Consonant Digraphs](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/pretest-3): Pretest 21 single-sound consonants and consonant digraphs including ch, ng, sh, th, wh.
- [Mastery Test: Consonants and Consonant Digraphs](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/test-3): Mastery test for 21 single-sound consonants and consonant digraphs.
- [Pretest: Multi-Letter Vowel Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/pretest-4): Pretest multi-letter vowel phonograms: ai, ay, eigh, ar, au, aw, ear, ee, er, ir, ur, igh, oa, oi, oy, or, our, ui, wor.
- [Mastery Test: Multi-Letter Vowel Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/test-4): Mastery test for multi-letter vowel phonograms including ai, ay, ee, igh, oa, and r-controlled vowels.
- [Pretest: 25 Vowel Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/pretest-5): Pretest 25 vowel phonograms including single vowel letters and multi-letter vowel teams.
- [Mastery Test: 25 Vowel Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/test-5): Mastery test covering 25 vowel phonograms including single vowels and multi-letter vowel teams.
- [Pretest: Alphabet Letters and Sounds](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/pretest-6): Pretest all 26 alphabet letters (a through z) and their associated sounds.
- [Mastery Test: Alphabet Letters and Sounds](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/test-6): Mastery test for all 26 alphabet letters and their sounds.
- [Pretest: 51 Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/pretest-7): Pretest 51 phonograms: all alphabet letters plus consonant digraphs and vowel phonograms.
- [Mastery Test: 51 Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/test-7): Mastery test for all 51 phonograms including alphabet letters, consonant digraphs, and vowel phonograms.
- [Pretest: Syllable Types](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/pretest-8): Pretest identifying the six syllable types across 36 words.
- [Mastery Test: Syllable Types](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/test-8): Mastery test for identifying the six syllable types.
- [Pretest: 60 Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/pretest-9): Pretest 60 phonograms including tch, ph, gh, gn, kn, wr, rh, dg, aigh.
- [Mastery Test: 60 Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/test-9): Mastery test for 60 phonograms including tch, ph, gh, gn, kn, wr, rh, dg, and aigh phonograms.
- [Pretest: 75 Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/pretest-10): Pretest all 75 phonograms from the complete Story Hour Academy curriculum.
- [Mastery Test: 75 Phonograms](https://www.storyhouracademy.org/test-10): Mastery test for all 75 phonograms from the complete curriculum.
